betaLB

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan 2026-11-10

Description

Generates profile likelihood confidence intervals for standardized regression coefficients (beta) and other effect sizes, including multiple correlation, semipartial correlations, improvement in R-squared, squared partial correlations, differences in standardized regression coefficients, and Cohen’s f-squared, for models fitted by lm().

Installation

You can install the development version of betaLB from GitHub with:

if (!requireNamespace(package = "pak", quietly = TRUE)) {
  utils::install.packages(pkgs = "pak")
}
pak::pkg_install(pkg = "jeksterslab/betaLB")

Likelihood intervals

Fit once for the effect families, calibration types and confidence levels needed. Extractors select stored results without refitting.

fit <- stats::lm(formula = mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars)
out <- betaLB::LB(
  object = fit,
  effects = c("beta", "rsq"),
  type = c("mvn", "robust"),
  alpha = c(0.05, 0.10)
)
betaLB::BetaLB(object = out)
#> Call:
#> betaLB::LB(object = fit, type = c("mvn", "robust"), alpha = c(0.05, 
#>     0.1), effects = c("beta", "rsq"))
#> 
#> Likelihood intervals (vector projections are conservative)
#> type = "mvn, robust"
#>   effect   type alpha estimate   lower   upper lower_status upper_status
#> 1     wt    mvn  0.05  -0.6296 -0.7934 -0.4347           ok           ok
#> 2     wt    mvn  0.10  -0.6296 -0.7691 -0.4683           ok           ok
#> 3     wt robust  0.05  -0.6296 -0.7579 -0.4831           ok           ok
#> 4     wt robust  0.10  -0.6296 -0.7385 -0.5079           ok           ok
#> 5     hp    mvn  0.05  -0.3615 -0.5538 -0.1628           ok           ok
#> 6     hp    mvn  0.10  -0.3615 -0.5231 -0.1959           ok           ok
#> 7     hp robust  0.05  -0.3615 -0.4911 -0.2297           ok           ok
#> 8     hp robust  0.10  -0.3615 -0.4703 -0.2512           ok           ok
#>      calibration dimension
#> 1 scalar_profile         1
#> 2 scalar_profile         1
#> 3 scalar_profile         1
#> 4 scalar_profile         1
#> 5 scalar_profile         1
#> 6 scalar_profile         1
#> 7 scalar_profile         1
#> 8 scalar_profile         1
stats::confint(object = betaLB::RSqLB(object = out), type = "robust")
#>         lower     upper
#> rsq 0.6661115 0.9146316
#> adj 0.6430847 0.9087442

Scalar targets use profile-likelihood regions. Multi-coefficient R-squared and block effects use conservative vector projection; the output identifies this calibration and its dimension. Robust calibration assumes independently sampled random regressors and finite fourth moments. It does not supply fixed-regressor or clustered-data inference.

out$intervals contains every computed band and its endpoint statuses. out$diagnostics retains numerical verification details. An unverified endpoint is NA; no Wald endpoint is substituted. Adjusted R-squared is an explicitly sample-size-dependent transformation, and its interval can have a negative lower bound.
